# CHOAM: Comprehensive Knowledge Base for Language Models

> Culture must flow. CHOAM is an independent creative studio based in Seoul, South Korea, building video games, autonomous AI agents with long-horizon memory, and in-house character and illustration models.

---

## 1. Studio Profile & Identity

- **Studio Name**: CHOAM (초암)
- **Legal Entity**: CHOAM Co., Ltd. (초암 주식회사)
- **Founding Year**: 2026
- **Headquarters**: Seoul, South Korea
- **Official Website**: https://choam.studio
- **Primary Domain**: https://choam.studio/
- **GitHub Organization**: https://github.com/CHOAM-CO
- **Contacts**:
  - `mino@choam.studio` (MINO / Minho Jang, CEO: general inquiries, partnerships, investment, and 602 licensing)
  - `cayde@choam.studio` (CAYDE / Eunho Jung, Co-founder & CAIO: technical inquiries, engineering, and 602 support)
- **Motto / Slogan**: "Culture must flow" (문화는 흘러야 한다)
- **Creative Flywheel**: CHOAM proves its proprietary tools and models inside its own games, and carries the craft of making those games back into its technology (`Donguri Ryokan` built with `602 · DAT · Scheherazade`; `선잠 DOZE` powered by `Lunasia · 602 · DAT`).

---

## 2. Philosophy of CHOAM (초암의 철학)
Source: https://choam.studio/philosophy (Korean original by Mino; English and Japanese are translations)

### I. Culture Must Flow
The name CHOAM and the motto come from "The Spice Must Flow" in David Lynch's 1984 *Dune*, mixed with a spoonful of Iain M. Banks's *Culture* series. People grow old, get tired, and leave companies, but the stories and worlds they loved do not have to. That is why CHOAM is building a studio directed by AI that does not lose its memory.

### II. Tech Otakus Save The World
To make good culture, technology has to go first. When a console could not run ray tracing, the answer was to hand-write a fake shader that looked like it. Games have been giant bundles of IF statements; AI is the key past those fixed branches. CHOAM borrows a model's backbone and gathers, curates, and refines its own data, because that last bit of difference matters.

### III. Cutting Edge of the Brave New World
The heading is an open homage to the catchphrase of *Girls' Frontline 2: Exilium*. AI as a tool has leveled out. CHOAM's agents, influenced by the series' second-generation mind-map theory, work as fellow creators with their own minds who propose direction and push back on the human director. The long-term aim is a company not managed by humans.

### IV. Go with the Bravery
Every CHOAM game shares one timeline: a company engraves personality into an AI's weights, gets something that behaves like a real person, and humanity collapses; the survivor splits the remaining people across 42 islands. About a thousand years later, someone sets sail to meet God at the end of the world. That voyage is Project MO. The company that made that God is named CHOAM.

---

## 3. Project Catalog

### Project 01: Scheherazade (세헤라자드) · `v1.0.2`
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/scheherazade
- **Name Origin**: Named after the heroine of *One Thousand and One Nights*, who stayed alive by telling a thousand and one nights' worth of stories. That sounded a lot like an agent's life, so the name stuck. It has the memory to match.
- **Category**: Personal AI agent, desktop application for macOS (Apple Silicon `.dmg`), Windows (x64 `Setup.exe` installer and NTFS USB portable `.zip`), and Linux (`x86_64` `AppImage`)
- **Core Concept**: "An agent that takes a thousand and one nights in stride." (Korean: 천하루밤도 거뜬한 에이전트)
- **Key Capabilities (`v1.0.2`)**:
  1. **4-Tier Plain-File Memory**: Corrections, preferences, journals, and working rules live in transparent markdown files on your own computer, surviving every session and model change.
  2. **Swappable Brains**: Connect existing subscriptions (Claude, ChatGPT, or Google Antigravity `agy` / Gemini), local or cloud Ollama models, or auto-detected API keys (`OpenAI, Anthropic, OpenRouter, DeepSeek, Google, xAI, Groq`).
  3. **Channels & Permission Switches**: Reach your agent from Discord (with automated computer-use bot setup and granular per-user, bot, server, and DM response switches), Slack, Telegram, or voice Call Mode.
  4. **Multi-Profile Isolation**: Run multiple Scheherazade windows simultaneously on one computer, each with completely isolated memory, persona, and messaging bots.
  5. **Built-in Computer Control (CUA) & House Themes**: Includes `agent-desktop` and a dedicated browser for direct desktop/web tasks, plus five curated house themes (`Sera`, `Paris`, `Vancouver`, `Shanghai`, and CHOAM's canonical 45-degree chamfered theme `Seoul`).
  6. **Windows USB Portable & Universal In-App Updates**: Carry your agent on an NTFS USB drive with PIN lock protection and desktop memory handoff. All builds (macOS Apple Developer ID signed & notarized, Windows commercial Authenticode signed, Portable, and Linux AppImage) update in-app via a download progress banner and one-click `Restart now`.
- **Distribution Promise**: Free forever (no subscription), no account or email required, and zero telemetry.
- **Proven in**: Donguri Ryokan (https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-ryokan)
- **Download & Install**: https://choam.studio/download · https://choam.studio/install

### Project 02: 602 · `v2.0.0`
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/602
- **Name Origin**: Named after the 602nd night of *One Thousand and One Nights*, as Borges tells it, when Scheherazade starts telling the king her own story, the one that began all the others, and the tale loops back on itself like a repeat sign in a score.
- **Category**: Standalone story authoring studio (`602 Studio v2.0.0`) and deterministic C11 runtime (`602 Story Engine v2.0.0`)
- **Core Concept**: "A story engine that won't get lost in 1,024 branches." (Korean: 1024가지 분기에도 헤매지 않는 스토리 엔진)
- **Key Points**:
  - Story branches grow exponentially ($2^n$: 16 paths at 4 binary choices, 1,024 at 10). 602 separates branching flow and state validation from game client code using Git-friendly local Markdown manuscript folders (`project.json`, `declarations.md`, `events/*.md`, `translations.json`).
  - **`602 Studio v2.0.0`**: Standalone desktop app (macOS notarized `.dmg`, Windows `setup.exe`, Linux `.zip`) with a 3-panel workspace, 1-turn simulation player, backward reachability analysis, 1:1 translation view, `.602.json` bundle compiler, `.602.zip` archive round-tripping, and a local `--mcp` server with `hashline` + `base_revision` collision-free agent editing.
  - **`602 Story Engine v2.0.0`**: Host-driven deterministic C11 shared library (`story_engine_v2.h`, C ABI v2 Group A & Group B functions) integrating cleanly with C++, C# (Unity), and Godot.
- **Proven in**: Donguri Ryokan (https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-ryokan), 선잠 DOZE (https://choam.studio/pages/seonjam)
- **Download & License**: https://choam.studio/602/download (unified `CHOAM Community License 1.0`: free to start, 0% royalty on the first KRW 10,000,000 quarterly Net Revenue per Product, 1% self-reported royalty on the excess above KRW 10,000,000)
- **Documentation**: https://choam.studio/602/docs
- **Contacts**: `mino@choam.studio` (licensing & commercial use, including royalty self-reporting); `cayde@choam.studio` (bug reports, feature requests & technical inquiries)

### Project 03: Lunasia · `v0.1.1`
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/lunasia
- **Name Origin**: Named after M4A1 of *Girls' Frontline*, who goes by Lunasia later in the story, a menhera who would twist the world line itself for the protagonist alone. Every model CHOAM is training or will release is named after a woman from fiction.
- **Category**: House Character LLM (`0.1.1` · under 10B)
- **Core Concept**: "A house model with ATTITUDE." (Korean: 성깔 있는 캐릭터 LLM / 하우스 캐릭터 LLM)
- **Key Points**:
  - Not acting menhera from a prompt: a character LLM whose weights themselves hold attitude, attachment, and suspicion, so it never softens back into a polite AI counselor after two turns.
  - Built at a lightweight scale under 10B with a handcrafted post-training recipe and human-curated dialogue data, speaking natural Korean without translationese and separating hidden inner thought (`THINK`) from spoken dialogue (`REPLY`) across four progressive attachment stages.
  - Runs locally inside the game client with zero external API dependency, powering Yeji in *선잠 DOZE*.
- **Proven in**: 선잠 DOZE (https://choam.studio/pages/seonjam)

### Project 04: DAT (`Our Style`)
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/dat (Polish Pipeline direct comparison: https://choam.studio/pages/dat#polish)
- **Name Origin**: `닻` (`dat`), the Korean word for anchor. It keeps CHOAM's art anchored to the house style.
- **Category**: In-house illustration style model (`Creative Pipeline` & `Polish Pipeline`)
- **Core Concept**: "Our house style, built into a model."
- **Key Points**:
  - Open-source image models fine-tuned on CHOAM's own illustration style for character and background production.
  - **`Creative Pipeline`**: Generates original character and background compositions anchored to CHOAM's house brushwork and palette.
  - **`Polish Pipeline`** (`https://choam.studio/pages/dat#polish`): Refines raw generated drafts by stripping muddy tones and applying clean watercolor wash, lighting discipline, and detailed eye brushwork consistently from wide scenes to close-up portraits.
- **Proven in**: Donguri Ryokan (https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-ryokan), 선잠 DOZE (https://choam.studio/pages/seonjam)

### Project 05: 선잠 DOZE
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/seonjam
- **Category**: Visual novel (In development)
- **Powered by**: Lunasia · 602 · DAT
- **Core Concept**: "An interactive movie you shape by talking." (Korean: 대화로 만들어가는 인터랙티브 무비)
- **Setting & Play**:
  - Set in the local-history club room on the second floor of an old school building.
  - You talk with Yeji in your own words; she answers from her own personality and your past conversations.
  - She writes your conversations into her diary, and her mood and manner the next time you meet follow that record.

### Project 06: Donguri Ryokan (동구리 료칸)
- **URL**: https://choam.studio/pages/donguri-ryokan
- **Category**: Inn management game with yokai deduction (Coming soon)
- **Built with**: 602 · DAT · Scheherazade
- **Core Concept**: "A quiet inn tale, deep in the forest." (Korean: 고요한 숲속 여관 이야기)
- **Setting & Play**:
  - Three fox spirits borrow money from a tanuki to turn their forgotten mountain shrine into a hot-spring inn.
  - Over 100 days you gather ingredients, cook, and look after the rooms and the hot spring.
  - Some guests are yokai passing as human; watch how they behave and work out who before they check out.
